nom: cocokind Peptide Fine Line Eye Gel

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report the gel as hydrating and helpful for dryness and smoothness under the eyes, with one dry-skin user pairing it with a heavier eye cream first for extra moisture.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report stinging, burning, redness, rashes, or allergic-type reactions around the eyes, while others with reactive skin, eczema, or sensitive eyes say it is gentle, non-irritating and finally tolerable.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin but dry under-eyes found it hydrating without stinging or irritation.
segments.mature: Mature-skin and older reviewers (late 20s to 48+) report visible softening of fine lines, crow's feet and smile lines, brighter under-eyes, and describe it as a budget alternative to pricier anti-aging creams.

concerns.aging: Most reviewers using it for fine lines, crow's feet and smile lines report gradual smoothing, plumping and brightening over weeks to months; a few see no visible change in lines despite continued use, and one felt it accentuated fine lines.
concerns.dehydration: Many describe the gel as lightweight yet hydrating, leaving under-eyes feeling smoother and plumper; one reviewer with dry skin found it less moisturizing than cocokind's other eye cream.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report new redness, red raised patches, red spots, or watering/stinging eyes after use, sometimes resolving only after stopping the product.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers describe burns, bumpy irritated skin, or a rash-like reaction around the eyes, though most other users report no irritation at all.
concerns.blemishes: Multiple reviewers explicitly praise the product for not causing milia, a recurring problem with other eye creams they've tried; one reviewer instead reports a breakout/rash around the eyes.
concerns.spots: Some reviewers note discoloration or dark circles improving, with brightening and reduced puffiness reported around the eye area.
concerns.oiliness: Not discussed by reviewers in relation to this eye product.

aspects.libelle: Wears well under makeup and concealer
Good value versus expensive eye creams

extraits.texte: I love cocokind and the revitalizing eye cream, so I wanted to give this a try. It burned the skin around my eyes and left it red and bumpy. Looked like i had a horrible sunburn. Do yourself a favor and buy the revitalizing eye cream instead

Unfortunately I had an adverse reaction to this product. Love the texture of it, and it felt great on my eyes until I developed a bit of an allergic reaction. Left my eyes puffy and itchy all day. I've made several attempts with this product to ensure it really is the cause of the reaction, and unfortunately it is. I'll stick to the Revitalizing Eye Cream, which works much better with my skin - no issues with that product!

extraits.titre: Great for undereyes and gentle on eczema!
extraits.texte: This gel is a really great eye moisturizer and has made an impact on my undereye circles. I have eczema on my eyes and this gel doesn't irritate it which is great! I have used this in rotation with a retinol eye balm and got really good results on reducing purple tones in my under eyes and fine lines. I would recommend! I will be trying it with the eye cream next.
I will forever get this because its the only thing so far that has not given me milia around my eyes.

I bought this about two weeks ago, so I cant say if my lines have diminished yet, however, the consistency of this eye cream is great. The pink color helps with darkness and brightens the undereye area. I love the feel of it, it's so hydrating and doesnt sting or irritate my eyes (I have oily skin but dry undereyes). I would definitely recommend this product!

extraits.titre: She may be small, but she puts in the WORK!
extraits.texte: This eye gel is one of my holy grail products! I love the thinner, serum-like consistency for daytime. I notice a huge difference in the look of my under eye area after using this since it launched. Its noticeably brighter, firmer, and smoother, which I appreciate as my skin is changing with age.

extraits.titre: Great formula, but major packaging issues
extraits.texte: Ill start by saying: I do really love the formula of this eye cream it looks great, it goes on so smooth and melts into my skin. I use it in the AM since it gives a bit more coverage than the Revitalizing Eye Cream, which I use at night. All that said, Ive had enough recurring issues with the packaging that I may stop using it altogether! The lid cracks each time, just from typical use of putting it gently on the counter. And excess product gets all over the pump, which is sadly a waste. Oddly enough I think its the same pump mechanism used for the Electrolyte Water Cream, which is phenomenal in that product. I thought it was a fluke at first, but Ive had the same issues happen three times now. Id really love to see this formula available with different or updated packaging!
